Asset Details by Floor and Partner
This dashboard allows users to view data related to the capacity of office space within the PSPC-administered office portfolio, including number of primary workpoints currently available.
It contains data for Office space located within Office Assets only.
Non-office assets and Special Purpose Space within Office assets are not reflected in this dashboard.
Occupancies managed by the Science and Parliamentary Infrastructure Branch are not reflected.

This section shows the net position of individual assets based on selected filters (region and/or partner). The different measures (e.g m2r, workpoints, surplus or deficit) are aggregated at the asset level for all partners accommodated at that address.
To view the measure for a given partner, select an asset by clicking on a table row. Press the Escape button to reset the view.

Lists each leased out space held by the selected partner, location, size (m²), FTEs accommodated (10% reduction applied), workpoints available, and projected surplus or deficit under three occupancy scenarios.

This section summarizes the results of the assessment of primary workpoints across the PSPC-administered office portfolio, viewable nationally, by region, and/or by partner. Filters applied here carry over to other dashboard sections.

This section shows asset-level data based on selected filters (region and/or partner), including occupancy details (as of November 3, 2025) and available primary workpoints.
Note: the occupancy data shown represents the aggregate data at the asset level for all partners accommodated at each address.
Clicking an asset in the Surplus (Deficit) by Asset section opens the Asset Details by Floor and Partner view, showing a stacking diagram, asset information, and partner occupancy details.

The fit-up type of a given asset is determined by the fit-up type of its floors. Unless a floor's current (observed) fit-up differs from the fit-up captured in SIGMA, the latter is used. "Mixed" fit-up type indicates that floors of an asset are fit-up using multiple standards.
The number of FTEs accommodated within an asset, as per active Lease-Out Contracts (also known as Occupancy Instruments), reduced by 10%.
N/A or N/R may be displayed in some data fields.

A real property office asset is a building or tower. Each building or tower is counted as one asset, but if a complex or campus comprises multiple towers or buildings, each tower or building will be counted individually as one asset (i.e. Guy Favreau complex is counted as 3 Assets). For leased properties, a building is counted once as a single asset, even if it contains multiple leases.
This field provides context about the asset or its occupancies, such as major construction underway or an assessment not required due to upcoming disposal or release.

The dashboard is based on SIGMA source data, the authoritative system of record, incorporating workpoint and fit-up information, all validated through regional review.
Calculations account for standard planning assumptions, and exclude non-office and Special Purpose Space.
Any data anomalies identified should be addressed through the National Reporting and Data Management's Business Intelligence Team .
Number of Assets Assessed : Total assets where all floors are either assigned a workpoint count or deemed not requiring assessment (e.g., storage or conference floors, etc.).

Number of Floors Assessed : Total floors assessed, meaning each has a workpoint count or is identified as not requiring assessment (e.g., storage or conference floors, etc.). Includes floors in fully and partially assessed assets.
Number of Workpoints : Total primary individual workpoints identified. Workpoint counts are gathered through site visits and floorplan reviews.
Number of Full-Time Equivalents (FTEs) : Total FTEs captured on the Occupancy Instruments included in the assessment, reduced by 10%.

60% Assigned : Displays the aggregate amount of surplus (positive number) or deficit (negative number) workpoints available or required for an in-office scenario where 60% of FTEs have an assigned workpoint and the remainder are unassigned. The aggregate amount sums all occupancy-level surpluses and deficits for the filtered selections.

80% Assigned : Displays the aggregate amount of surplus (positive number) or deficit (negative number) workpoints available or required for an in-office scenario where 80% of FTEs have an assigned workpoint and the remainder are unassigned. The aggregate amount sums all occupancy-level surpluses and deficits for the filtered selections.

Fully Assigned : Displays the aggregate amount of surplus (positive number) or deficit (negative number) workpoints available or required for an in-office scenario where 100% of FTEs have an assigned workpoint. The aggregate amount sums all occupancy-level surpluses and deficits for the filtered selections.
N/A : Assessment completed, but no primary workpoints are present—often due to vacancy, decommissioning, or space not fit-up as office (e.g., SPS misidentified, conference room, etc.).
N/R : Region deemed assessment Not Required, typically due to upcoming disposal/release or security restrictions (e.g., Public Safety Special).
